entities.summary: Francisco Maciel García is a former tennis player from Mexico. He reached his highest singles ATP-ranking in June 1986 of world No. 35. Maciel represented his native country as a qualifier at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, where he was defeated in the first round by Switzerland's Jakob Hlasek. He won the silver medal at the 1984 Summer Olympics, when tennis was a demonstration sport. Francisco Maciel was a athletes & competitors from Santiago de Querétaro (b. 1964-07-01, Santiago de Querétaro). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
